Market today: The big story is the 10-year Treasury yield crossing a key threshold. Rising yields typically hit growth and tech stocks hard, which is a direct headwind for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern with a -55.68% loss on a leveraged ETF; your stop is way off. SPAL is also down -36.82% and leveraged, with an inactive stop. SMH (-12.53%) and QQQI (-3.21%) are both near their trim stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields. Continued increases will likely put more pressure on your tech/chip names. Also, monitor the broader market for September weakness.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged and underperforming positions, especially with rising yields.
plays: SOXL: Your -55.68% loss on this leveraged ETF is brutal. Consider cutting it now; the default stop at 200 is irrelevant.
SMH: Watch your 540 stop. If it breaks, trim as planned to manage the -12.53% loss.
QQQI: Keep an eye on your 52 stop. If it hits, trim to protect your -3.21% loss.
